Class Repository

java.lang.Object
library.persistence.Repository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class Repository extends Object implements Closeable
Repository is a class responsible for managing data structures and transactions related to users, books, their associations, notifications, and borrowing operations. It communicates with an underlying database structure using several maps and provides mechanisms to ensure data integrity during updates and modifications. Implements Closeable to ensure resources are properly released.
